title: Managing after-hours property manager hours: how to stop the constant maintenance cycle

blocks.text: Why property manager hours bleed into the night

Property management is a reactive industry. Pipes burst and locks break without regard for your working hours. The core issue is that many managers operate as the primary middleman for every single maintenance request. When you handle every phone call or email personally, you never truly disconnect. This lack of boundaries leads to high stress and turnover.
The true cost of reactive after-hours coordination

The financial impact of poor after-hours management goes beyond just your personal time. When you are constantly reacting, you lose the ability to focus on long-term portfolio growth. You spend your day in a cycle of administrative tasks. This is where the 19.5 hours of lost time per week accumulates. It is not just about the hours worked. It is about the quality of that work.

You can change how you manage your time without buying expensive new tools. Start by defining what a true emergency is. Write these guidelines down and send them to every tenant when they move in. A gas leak or fire is an emergency. A squeaky cabinet door is not. When tenants understand the difference, your after-hours phone calls will drop significantly.
Using your Mac to manage communication

Your Mac is a powerful tool for maintaining boundaries. Use the Mail app to set up smart folders for maintenance requests. You can also use macOS Login Items in System Settings > General > Login Items to ensure your primary dashboard is always ready when you start your day. If you use iMessage, turn on Text Message Forwarding in Settings > Messages on your iPhone to handle tenant texts directly on your Mac keyboard.
Use the ⌥ ⌘ shortcut to ask Lazur to summarize your current email thread. This helps you quickly identify if a request is a genuine emergency or something that can wait until the morning.

faq.question: How can I stop tenants from calling me late at night?
faq.answer: Define clear emergency protocols in your lease agreement and during move-in. Use an automated answering service to triage calls so that only true emergencies reach you.

fixes.title: Define emergency protocols
fixes.text: Create a written list of what qualifies as an emergency and share it with all tenants.
